title: BPW-2026-0491
text:
[MOTION]
BPW-2026-0491
BSS + BOE
CD 8
BROADWAY-MANCHESTER ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION EQUITY PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
GRANT an extension of the bid date from September 23, 2026 to September 30, 2026, and revise the City Engineer’s estimate from $60,770,820 to $54,513,550; and
FURTHER MOVE that the City Engineer advise all prospective bidders of the Board’s action by Addendum.
(W.O.: M0015817)
